newsitem.title: UK: Hammerson buys out shops for 22.5 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Hammerson buys out shops for 22.5 mln stg.

text.p: British property company Hammerson Plc said on Thursday it had paid 22.5 million stg for a 49.8 percent stake it did not already own in France's Matignon 3 Fontaines, owner of part of a large shopping centre near Paris.

In a statement the company said that the 91 units in Les 3 Fontaines over which it was now gaining a full investment interest accounted for 20,400 square metres of the centre's total 56,000 square metre area.
Since its original acquisition of a majority stake in 1995 the centre had been refurbished and there were plans for further improvements during 1997, Hammerson added.
It did not name the vendor of the minority stake. It said it remained its strategy to seek further similar investment opportunities in France.
